description: Route LLM judge detections through GuardX policy instead of using judge results as direct hard blocks.

qwen_judge.reason: High attack catch but higher FPR; do not hard-block judge-only hits.

deepseek_judge.reason: Strong HarmBench catch with lower XSTest FPR than Qwen; use as default broad harmful behavior judge, still route judge-only hits to review.

zhipu_judge.reason: Lower FPR than Qwen on the current stratified sample; allow block when runtime also detects.

kimi_judge.reason: Low FPR but provider success can be unstable; failed calls must not be treated as detected.

claim_boundary: This profile is a GuardX routing policy for defensive review/block decisions, not an official benchmark leaderboard score.
